use_cases: Displaying animated headlines or titles in hero sections and marketing pages
Creating visually engaging loading or placeholder text states
Adding visual polish to call-to-action buttons and section headers
Enhancing feature highlights with eye-catching animated typography
Using as decorative animated text elements in landing pages
ai_summary: A lightweight React component that applies a continuous horizontal shimmer animation to text using CSS gradients and Framer Motion. The text displays a gradient background that moves from left to right infinitely, creating a polished metallic shine effect. Supports customization via className and includes both light and dark mode gradient variants. Perfect for adding visual interest to headings, loading states, and decorative text elements.
